Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinodanand Barthwal, learned counsel for the
petitioner (appeared through V.C.).
2. This contempt petition is filed under Section 12 of the
Contempt of Courts Act, 1971. The petitioner alleges willful
and deliberate contempt of this Court's order dated
13.05.2026, passed in WPSB No.34 of 2025, Shiv Moha Shukla
vs. State of Uttarakhand & another, whereby petitioner was
granted liberty to make representation and the concerned
respondents was directed to decide the same in accordance
with law.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that
representation, pursuant to the aforesaid order passed by Writ
Court was submitted on 15.05.2026 to the respondents-contemnors, but till date, the same has not been decided.
4. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors, returnable
within four weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6. List on 22.09.2026.
7. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor may either file
response/counter affidavit or to comply with the order passed
by the Writ Court.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
